```yaml
name: Blob Size Policy
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
jobs:
  check-pinned-action:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Verify setup-zig action is pinned
        run: |
          echo "Checking that mlugg/setup-zig is pinned to the immutable SHA in workflow files..."
          # Find all workflow files
          files=$(git ls-files .github/workflows/*.yml)
          for file in $files; do
            if grep -q "mlugg/setup-zig@d1434d08867e3ee9daa34448df10607b98908d29" "$file"; then
              echo "✓ $file contains pinned SHA."
            else
              echo "✗ $file does not contain pinned SHA."
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "All workflow files contain the pinned setup-zig action."
```
